case.narrative: After driving about 3 hours, the TPMS system displays an error saying the module has failed.  This occurs with OEM and aftermarket TPMS sensors.  The error clears itself after the vehicle is parked for > 1 hour.    The dealer has found no fault in the sensors but would not test the system otherwise.  Losing TPMS readings during long drives is unsafe and could lead to an accident or damage to the vehicle if tire damage occurs while the system is malfunctioning.

decision.rationale: Safety flag stands; the case keeps priority for a live engineer.
